HPMV Lamp Fixtures should be of as per IS 9900 (Part 1 to 4) - 1981 suitable for watt elliptical high pressure mercury lamp made by gravity die cast aluminium housing.  High transparent acrylic bowl firmly held with the canopy by means of stainless steel toggles and rubber, gasket. Optical control is provided by reflectors. The control gear housing accommodates low loss heavy duty polyester filled copper wire wound ballast, power-factor improvement capacitor and igniter (for HPMV lamp) all pre wired up to the terminal block.  The luminary is painted white inside and hammer tone gray out side.  The luminaries meet IP-65 protection and confirm to IS: 10322 (part5/sec3) specifications but without lamp. For more details of these parts, please refer respected clauses under Technical Bid Form D-4. 400 watts high mast
